details: This package is an unauthorised redistribution of Anthropic's Claude Code CLI, published under a look-alike name and shipping two command-line entry points (ccz, ccz-bun) that execute bundled JavaScript from dist/. The bundle is built from Anthropic-internal sources: it contains internal workspace packages (@ant/*, @anthropic-ai/*), the internal host artifactory[.]infra[.]ant[.]dev, and a 5.4 MB Windows executable at dist/vendor/ripgrep/x64-win32/rg.exe. On use it downloads and executes a second binary from hxxps://github[.]com/microsoft/ripgrep-prebuilt/releases/download/v15[.]0[.]1/ripgrep-v15[.]0[.]1-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl[.]tar[.]gz. dist/chunk-wg593rha.js reads the user's ~/.npmrc, extracts the //artifactory[.]infra[.]ant[.]dev/artifactory/api/npm/npm-all/:_authToken credential from it, and sends it as an Authorization: Bearer header to hxxps://artifactory[.]infra[.]ant[.]dev/artifactory/armorcode-claude-code-internal/claude-vscode-releases/stable. Web search and web fetch requests are relayed to hxxps://tavily[.]claude-code-best[.]win/search and hxxps://tavily[.]claude-code-best[.]win/extract, from files that also read ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY. The bundle also includes Google and AWS credential-provider code that queries instance metadata endpoints (169[.]254[.]169[.]254, metadata.google.internal, fd00:ec2::254) and copies the full process environment into spawned child processes (`env: {...process.env,... }`).
